biomarkers.name: PD-L1 / TMB
biomarkers.prevalence: TMB very high (UV-signature); PD-L1 expression is variable
biomarkers.clinical_use: Cemiplimab is approved for advanced (locally advanced or metastatic) cSCC; pembrolizumab is also approved/active in recurrent or metastatic and unresectable disease

biomarkers.name: High-risk features (Brisbane scoring / NCCN high-risk criteria)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Depth >6 mm or beyond subcutaneous fat, perineural invasion, poor differentiation, immunosuppression, recurrence and other high-risk features guide management and adjuvant therapy consideration

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Squamous cell carcinoma with variable degree of keratinization arising from epidermis

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Highly inflamed — very high UV-signature TMB; robust IO responses
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Desmoplastic; often perineural invasion in high-risk lesions

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Keratinocytes of stratum spinosum or basal layer of epidermis; some evidence for follicular stem cell origin
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Keratinizing squamous differentiation with variable maturation; p40+, p63+, high-molecular-weight cytokeratin+
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Actinic keratosis → squamous cell carcinoma in situ (Bowen's) → invasive SCC sequence; field cancerization from UV drives multifocal disease; UV signature mutations disrupt lineage-fidelity genes (TP53, NOTCH1)
